title: Knp? Saham Teknologi Raksasa Runtuh Berjamaah
subtitle: Valuasi Semu, Bakar Uang & Jebakan Diskon
description: Saham teknologi global maupun lokal rontok karena model bisnis bakar uang dan janji masa depan gagal menghasilkan laba nyata secepat ekspektasi investor.

beats.title: Saham Tech Runtuh
beats.narration: Pernah nggak sih kamu mikir, kenapa saham perusahaan teknologi yang aplikasinya kita pakai tiap hari—mulai dari raksasa akal imitasi dunia sampai belanja online lokal—mendadak anjlok berjamaah dan menghapus nilai ribuan triliun rupiah?

beats.title: Ilusi Bakar Uang
beats.narration: Selama bertahun-tahun, saham teknologi dinilai bukan dari untung nyatanya, tapi dari seberapa heboh janjinya. Di Indonesia, mereka bakar uang triliunan buat kasih diskon dan gratis ongkir. Di Amerika, raksasa teknologi bakar ribuan triliun buat borong mesin akal imitasi.

beats.title: Jebakan Diskon & AI
beats.narration: Masalahnya meledak saat uang yang dibakar nggak balik modal secepat itu! Di dunia, muncul pesaing baru yang jauh lebih hemat biaya, bikin saham chip raksasa langsung rontok. Di Indonesia, begitu diskon distop demi cari untung, pembeli sepi sampai Bukalapak tutup layanan belanja barang fisiknya.

beats.title: Anjlok 85% Dari Pucuk
beats.narration: Di bursa kita, saham teknologi yang dulunya dijual ratusan rupiah saat pertama masuk pasar, kini terjun bebas kehilangan lebih dari delapan puluh lima persen nilainya. Era membeli saham cuma karena janji manis masa depan sudah resmi tamat.

beats.title: 3 Filter Saham Tech
beats.narration: Pelajaran pentingnya buat dompet kita: aplikasi yang ramai dipakai belum tentu perusahaannya cetak untung. Sebelum ikut beli, cek apakah bisnisnya beneran untung tanpa bakar uang, dan apakah produknya tetap laku tanpa subsidi diskon. Sekarang kamu tahu kenapa.

title: Knp? Bursa Saham Kita Terancam Diboikot Dunia
subtitle: Saham Rp1.500T, Free Float Cuma 3%
description: Bursa saham Indonesia terancam diturunkan wasit dunia dari liga utama ke zona isolasi karena saham raksasa Rp1.500 triliun ternyata 97 persennya dikunci empat orang dan cuma 3 persen yang dijual bebas ke warga.

beats.title: Ancaman Turun Kasta
beats.narration: Pernah nggak sih kamu mikir, kenapa bursa saham kita tiba-tiba anjlok delapan persen sampai perdagangan dibekukan sementara? Ternyata, wasit bursa saham dunia bernama MSCI baru saja memberi ancaman keras: ibarat dari liga utama dunia, Indonesia terancam diturunkan paksa ke kasta terendah—zona isolasi selevel negara yang lagi krisis berat.

beats.title: Cuma 3% Di Pasar
beats.narration: Akar masalahnya ada di saham yang beneran dijual bebas ke warga biasa. Bayangin ada perusahaan raksasa seharga seribu lima ratus triliun rupiah—lebih mahal dari Bank BCA. Tapi ternyata, sembilan puluh tujuh persen sahamnya dikunci rapat oleh empat pemilik aslinya saja. Yang beneran beredar di pasar? Cuma tiga persen!

beats.title: Jebakan Dana Asing
beats.narration: Karena barangnya langka banget, harga sahamnya gampang banget digoreng naik berkali-kali lipat. Masalahnya, reksa dana raksasa dunia punya sistem komputer otomatis yang wajib beli saham terbesar di tiap negara. Kalau saham yang cuma tiga persen tadi masuk daftar wajib beli, uang triliunan milik bule bakal terjebak beli di harga pucuk—dan pas mau jual, nggak ada pembelinya!

beats.title: Saham Nyangkut
beats.narration: Begitu wasit dunia menolak saham seperti ini dan mengancam membekukan Indonesia, investor besar langsung panik tarik uang. Tanpa ampun, harga saham langsung ambruk mentok batas bawah berhari-hari, uang asing kabur, dan nilai lebih dari lima ratus triliun rupiah menguap begitu saja.

beats.title: Lanjut Di YouTube
beats.narration: Terus gimana cara pemerintah menyelamatkan bursa kita dari ancaman boikot dunia, dan tiga cara simpel mengecek saham biar tabunganmu nggak ikut nyangkut? Tonton bedah lengkapnya di YouTube Kausal Media sekarang!

title: The AI Bubble: What It Actually Is
subtitle: $600B CapEx vs Reality
description: The AI bubble is not just hype—it is a $500B revenue gap funded by round-trip cloud accounting and masked by aggressive 6-year GPU depreciation schedules on 3-year silicon obsolescence cycles.

beats.title: The $600B Chasm
beats.narration: Everyone calls AI a bubble, but almost nobody explains what is actually inflating. Between 2025 and 2026, Microsoft, Meta, Google, and Amazon are spending over three hundred and twenty billion dollars a year on AI data centers. Yet according to Sequoia's famous six-hundred-billion-dollar formula, all pure-play AI software today earns less than forty-five billion—leaving a massive five-hundred-billion-dollar revenue chasm.

beats.title: Round-Trip Revenue
beats.narration: Why does cloud revenue look so booming anyway? Because of a Wall Street illusion called round-tripping. Hyperscalers invest tens of billions into AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic—not just in cash, but in cloud compute credits. When those startups burn those credits training models on Azure or AWS, Big Tech books its own investment right back as cloud revenue.

beats.title: The Depreciation Clock
beats.narration: The real time bomb sits on the balance sheet. Tech giants stretch their server depreciation schedules to six full years to keep quarterly profits looking high. But Nvidia launches a new GPU architecture every twelve to twenty-four months. When Blackwell and Rubin make older chips too power-hungry to run economically, hundreds of billions in silicon face sudden write-downs.

beats.title: 2000 Telecom vs 2026 AI
beats.narration: Is this just the year-two-thousand telecom crash all over again? Not quite. In two thousand, telecoms used junk debt to lay dark fiber cables that lasted twenty-five years in the ground. Today's tech giants are funding AI out of massive cash flows—but they are buying fast-rotting GPUs that lose value in just three years.

beats.title: What Pops vs Survives
beats.narration: So what actually pops when the AI bubble deflates? Overvalued wrapper startups selling generic chatbots on rented compute will get wiped out as model costs fall toward zero. Meanwhile, the real winners—power grid infrastructure and deep workflow automation—will buy up that discounted compute for pennies on the dollar.

title: Offshore Investing Tax Traps (Indonesia): 0.1% vs 35%
subtitle: Indonesian Offshore Stock Tax Traps (0.1% vs 35%)
description: Indonesian offshore investors face progressive income tax up to 35% on global capital gains and a 40% US estate tax on direct holdings above $60,000. Navigating international investing requires Irish-domiciled accumulating UCITS ETFs, PMK 18 repatriation for 0% dividend tax, and full AEOI/CRS compliance.

beats.title: Capital Gains Asymmetry
beats.narration: Sell 1 billion rupiah of BCA stock on the IDX, and your final tax is 0.1% or 1 million rupiah. Done. Sell that exact same gain on Apple, or the S&P 500 from Jakarta, and Indonesia's worldwide tax rules kick in. Under the UU HPP tax law, offshore capital gains are ordinary income. Taxed progressively up to 35%, that's a 350 times tax shock.

beats.title: The US Estate Tax Trap
beats.narration: Most Indonesian investors open interactive brokers, Pluang, or go trade to buy direct US shares. Filing form W-8BEN cuts US dividend withholding from 30% down to 15%, creditable back home through PPh 24. But here's the trap. The US estate tax. If you're not an American citizen, the IRS gives you an exemption of just $60,000 Above that, the IRS takes up to 40% upon death, and Indonesia has zero estate tax treaty with the US

beats.title: Irish UCITS ETFs Bypass
beats.narration: Smart investors bypass both traps, using Irish domiciled UCITS ETFs on the London Stock Exchange, like CSPX for the S&P 500, or VWRA for global equities. First, Ireland's US treaty caps internal dividend withholding at 15%, while charging 0% outbound withholding to you. Second, Irish funds are non-US assets, that 40% US estate tax drops to zero. Best of all, accumulating shares reinvest dividends inside the fund, triggering zero annual dividend tax events.

beats.title: Foreign Dividend Exemption
beats.narration: What if you receive cash dividends from abroad? By default, Indonesia taxes foreign dividends as ordinary income, up to 35%. Here's the legal escape hatch. Under the omnibus law and PMK 18 2021, foreign dividends are 100% tax exempt if you repatriate and reinvest them in Indonesia before March 31. Lock the money into Indonesian government SBN bonds, mutual funds, or deposits for three consecutive years, and your tax rate drops to zero.

beats.title: CFC Rules & CRS Transparency
beats.narration: Can you hide behind a Singapore holding company or a BVI paper shell? Don't try it. Under PMK 93 2019, controlled foreign corporation rules treat passive gains and offshore entities you control as deemed dividends, taxing them anyway. Worse, bank secrecy is dead. Under the CRS global agreement, over 100 countries, including Singapore and Switzerland automatically report your account balances to the DJP every September. Unreported offshore assets risk penalties up to 200%.

beats.title: Three-Tier Implementation Playbook
beats.narration: Here's your three tier playbook. One, under $60,000 direct US stocks with W-8BEN are acceptable. Two, above $60,000 switch entirely to Irish accumulating UCITS ETFs like CSPX and VWRA. You eliminate the 40% US estate tax, stop dividend drag, and report your acquisition cost in your annual SPT tax return. Three, for cash dividends, repatriate into Indonesian SBN bonds for three years under PMK 18 to lock in zero percent tax. Structure properly and keep your gains.

title: Humane AI Pin: The $699 Hardware Collapse
subtitle: When Daily Returns Surpassed New Sales
description: A venture-backed hardware failure where telecom IMEI constraints turned returns into unrefurbishable e-waste, driving negative sales velocity until HP acquired the software and bricked the hardware.

beats.title: Sales & Returns Inversion
beats.narration: For three months, more people returned the AI Pin than bought one.

beats.title: Launch & Negative Velocity
beats.narration: Humane pitched a $699 lapel pin designed to replace the smartphone. They shipped about 10,000 units, pulling in roughly $9 million. Then net sales went negative. Between May and August 2024, daily returns consistently surpassed new orders.

beats.title: Carrier Locking & E-Waste Trap
beats.narration: Over $1 million in hardware bounced back to their warehouse. Worse, Humane couldn't even resell the returned devices. Because of T-Mobile carrier locking constraints, they couldn't wipe and reassign the internal cellular chips. Thousands of returned pins turned directly into e-waste.

beats.title: Asset Sale & Hardware Abandonment
beats.narration: By August, active users dropped below 7,000. And in February 2025, HP bought Humane's software assets for $116 million, ditching the hardware entirely.

beats.title: Cloud Shutdown & Bricked Hardware
beats.narration: On February 28, the cloud servers shut down. Every pin, bricked instantly. That's $699 for a silent metal badge.
